issue.title: Adopt Phase 1 agent/process docs (no merge-gate changes)
issue.body:
## Summary

Add high-value, non-blocking process/agent patterns to fluent-mobile: issue tracking + CI docs, slimmer PR template, `/onboard` + `/dep-bump` commands, warn-only session env check, and short nested hot-path notes under `src/services/` and `src/db/`.

**Out of scope / do not add in this ticket:** Conventional Commits / PR-title CI, required CODEOWNERS reviews, fail-deny convention hooks for design tokens, heavy feature-scaffold layers, or any new required branch-protection checks.

## Context

fluent-mobile already has strong delivery judgment (`AGENTS.md`, Android-only, architecture layers, Dependabot workflow). This ticket improves documentation contracts and agent discovery UX without tightening merge gates.

**Ticket tracker for this repo (for now):** GitHub Issues (not Linear).

## Scope

### In scope
- [ ] `docs/issue-tracking.md` — GitHub Issues, branch naming, PR linking (`Closes #NNN`)
- [ ] `docs/ci.md` — workflow map + future required-check / `paths:` deadlock guardrail (docs only; no CI behavior change)
- [ ] Slimmer `.cursor/templates/pr-template.md` (keep AGENTS AC/scope/device-QA; drop rarely filled sections)
- [ ] `.cursor/commands/onboard.md` — Android-only setup guidance
- [ ] `.cursor/commands/dep-bump.md` — `expo install` + `npm run doctor`
- [ ] Warn-only Cursor session env check (`.cursor/hooks.json` + script) — never deny
- [ ] Short nested notes: `src/services/AGENTS.md`, `src/db/AGENTS.md`
- [ ] Wire pointers from onboarding / docs rules / delivery commands so GitHub Issues is the documented tracker

### Out of scope
- New required CI checks or branch protection changes
- CODEOWNERS with required reviews
- commitlint / PR title lint
- Hard-deny convention guards
- Dual agent-tooling trees beyond what Cursor already needs

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] New docs and commands exist and match fluent-mobile conventions (npm, Android-only, Expo SDK 56)
- [ ] No workflow YAML behavior changes that could block merges
- [ ] Session env hook is warn-only / fail-open
- [ ] PR template still includes AGENTS delivery checkboxes (AC, scope, Android device QA)
- [ ] Onboarding + docs index link the new issue-tracking and CI docs
- [ ] Local gates pass: `format:check`, `lint`, `typecheck`, `test --ci`

## Verification

```bash
npm run format:check
npm run lint
npm run typecheck
npm test -- --ci
```

Manual: open `/onboard` and `/dep-bump` command files; confirm hooks.json sessionStart is warn-only.
